events.title: Cheap Trick
events.description:
Get ready for an unforgettable, high-energy night along the river with Cheap Trick! This legendary rock band brings their electrifying sound to the outdoor stage for a must-see concert experience. Sing along to iconic hits like “I Want You To Want Me,” “The Flame,” and “Surrender,” and feel the nostalgia and adrenaline of classic rock done right. Grab your friends, soak up the summer vibes, and don’t miss your chance to see these rock legends live. Get your tickets today before they’re gone! 
Special Guest James Hatem
James Hatem is a Nashville-based singer-songwriter originally from New Jersey, known for his raw, guitar-driven sound and emotionally honest songwriting. Blending blues, rock, and Americana influences, his music draws from artists like John Mayer, The Beatles, Jimi Hendrix, and The Band- delivering a modern yet timeless feel that resonates both live and on record. A relentless performer, Hatem has toured extensively across the U.S. and built a reputation for captivating, high-energy live shows. In 2021, he made headlines after performing 80 shows in 24 hours across Nashville in an attempt at a Guinness World Record.
